notes.semetey-1-2013:p0064:b003:l001: Departing means dying here, clarified by the parallel verse 4. Honor/shame motivates the lament.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0064:b003:l020: The oath invokes the father’s grave; the following line explicitly calls the world shit. Both are retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0064:b003:l023: The narrator first calls Kanykei accomplished and knowledgeable, then compares her to a witless woman and says she abuses God. The printed tension is retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0064:b004:l005: Суусар specifically marten, not sable; corrected from draft after Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/суусар/. Кош-коштоп adorned in pairs retains compressed decorative phrasing.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0064:b004:l013: Literally making the woman’s head a banner; provisionally Kanykei’s own authority as a woman, paired with governing the people.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0064:b004:l023: Harrier raised into a hunting bird is the original metaphor for gathering marginal people into a nation, not a biological transformation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0064:b004:l028: Ocean is an epithet for Manas; literal ocean imagery is retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0065:b003:l001: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0065:b003:l006: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0065:b003:l030: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0065:b005:l004: Кысыр эмди denotes a calf suckling a cow that has not borne another calf; not a barren calf.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0065:b005:l010: Жинин кактым idiom knocked arrogance out of her, verified exact Yudakhin жинин какты, https://el-sozduk.kg/zhin-6/. Karymbai's boast, not narrator endorsement.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0065:b005:l018: Умаш is small flour/dough pellets, retained as the eye-size simile. The sentence is Karymbai’s abusive boast.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0065:b005:l022: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0065:b005:l036: Багын provisionally garden in this sequence of places seen; fortune is a lexical alternative.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0066:b003:l013: Марча is a mountain salt lick, verified in Yudakhin, https://el-sozduk.kg/marcha/. Repeated white salt lick preserved.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0066:b003:l019: Борук is a two-year-old wether in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/борук/. Etymological dictionary disputes uniform age terminology; translation follows Yudakhin here. Кер is brown.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0066:b003:l022: Proverb literally promises fresh fish to someone who has not died: unexpected sustenance while alive. Fish retained though actual gift is a sheep.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0066:b003:l027: Printed мурда жалккан кара бет, provisionally the shamefaced woman previously exhausted; жалккан reading/attachment uncertain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0066:b003:l032: Baabedin and Koroshon are invoked sacred patrons; sheep is vowed to the latter. Hair ornaments placed around the neck are a prayer gesture, not silently removed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0066:b004:l016: The daughter is explicitly called эр, a hero; not silently changed to beauty.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0066:b004:l021: Kanykei line introduces a compressed sequence about the child as her banner and Chyiyrdy's gift from Manas. References inferred from surrounding cradle-child description; no source words changed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0066:b004:l032: Акка мойнун бурду interpreted as turning toward God/the Truth in this religious context; not a physical white object.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0067:b003:l014: Printed Tappat retained as the source's name for a Quranic surah, without imposing a modern chapter identification.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0067:b003:l016: Kulkuldabat retained as the printed oral name of a Quranic recitation; not replaced by an unverified Arabic chapter name.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0067:b003:l020: Эки ашым literally two meal portions, retained in dedication of sheep to Manas's spirit.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0067:b003:l026: Printed бир сабын literally one handle/part of handle. Provisionally child shares hold of ceremonial slaughter blade; no separate second weapon invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0067:b005:l002: Аябаган дүмөктү сала келген literally brought/imposed merciless trouble. Retained despite nearby praise of Chyiyrdy's foresight in bringing cauldron. Дүмөк confirmed trouble/threat, https://el-sozduk.kg/дүм/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0067:b005:l006: Жан казан provisionally small/personal cauldron, rather than soul-cauldron; exact жан modifier uncertain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0067:b005:l018: Бор кайнатып idiom vigorous boiling, not boiling chalk; established Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/bor-6/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0067:b005:l024: Боконолуу моюн эт provisionally bony neck meat. Compressed transition from portion distribution to Semetey's appetite; no unprinted recipient added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0068:b003:l018: Karakan and Temir Khan both retained as printed destinations/person designations, not silently harmonized.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0068:b003:l033: Printed алам көчүңдү: take your camp/migration from Keng-Kol. Directional tension with return-and-revenge narrative retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0068:b003:l036: Printed сартымды retained as my Sart (settled Central Asian person); possible corruption of шарт vow not silently substituted. Revenge against Karymbai may motivate the phrase, but identification not asserted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0068:b004:l033: Таалайды жеген literally ate/consumed fortune. Metaphor retained without smoothing away grief.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0069:b003:l017: Chyiyrdy explicitly says my beard is white; gender/formula tension retained, not rewritten as hair.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0069:b004:l003: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0069:b004:l011: Буудай wheat retained as apparent praise/metaphor for Manas in burial context. Not silently replaced with infant or grain provisions.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0069:b004:l034: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0070:b003:l007: Шай III invisible patron of warriors, originally Shaimerden; exact шай колдогон шер болот in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/шай/. Rendered singular holy patron rather than plural.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0070:b003:l011: Бузуп көч алар forceful breaking and taking of camps retained; not merely peaceful return.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0070:b003:l021: A pit, boiling misfortune, dark road, vulture and rushing water are addressed as witnesses to mother's unwelcome words; all retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0070:b004:l005: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0070:b004:l027: Short printed line Kanykei child I retained separately; visually it begins at normal column margin and is not an indented typographic continuation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0070:b004:l039: Чыбыры provisionally brush/twig covered, exact adjective uncertain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0071:b003:l008: Кара жолтой literally dark-fortuned child; source's troubling epithet retained despite praise of Semetey elsewhere.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0071:b003:l020: Printed walked without tiring followed immediately by nearly exhausted; both assertions retained without harmonizing.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0071:b003:l021: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0071:b003:l025: Маасы soft boots retained although later stockings/no boots and subsequent boots recur. Clothing-state tensions not silently repaired.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0071:b004:l019: Энекең минген зардабы refers to consequence of Chyiyrdy riding on Kanykei's back, inferred from explicit carrying scene.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0071:b004:l025: Тушар ankle depth, with fire metaphor. Compare Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/тушар/; not arbitrary knee or waist depth.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0072:b003:l023: Printed Жорго минбес Kanykei who does not ride an ambler retained, not silently reversed to one accustomed to riding.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0072:b004:l004: Буурусун plow and чийин furrow distinguish next чий grass. No invented cultivation in the barren land.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0072:b004:l015: Gnawed-clean head metaphor for gaunt Kanykei retained; not softened to general tiredness.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0073:b003:l027: Көргөзмөкчү болдуң сонунду literally you mean to show a marvel, bitterly ironic complaint to God; not translated as genuine delight.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0073:b005:l004: Кол бергеним ritual giving of hand to spiritual patron Kozhakmat, not commercial promise.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0073:b005:l008: Бирлерим read as пирлерим spiritual patrons, established Kyrgyz бир II = пир; https://el-sozduk.kg/БИР/. Кемел perfected.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0073:b005:l011: Black-spotted leopard and short-tailed lion invoked as Manas's supernatural helpers; no rationalization into human warriors.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0073:b005:l019: Жыңайлак read as жылаңайлак barefoot; red dervish retained without invented proper identity. Raw glyphs unchanged.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0073:b005:l038: Begins imagined accusation continued onto next page. Quotation punctuation will be finalized with continuation; no whole sentence inferred from this partial boundary.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0074:b003:l018: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0074:b003:l021: Kanykei explicitly proposes stabbing her own lung and dying in sacrifice. Literary source content retained without softening or added instructions.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0074:b004:l007: Чампаң read as чампан, foreign/unclear-language speakers; Seytek1960 editorial glossary PDF262 defines Чампан тили түшүнүксүз. https://new.bizdin.kg/media/books/Сейтек._1960_г..pdf. No exact place name asserted; raw spelling unchanged.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0074:b004:l010: Stepping over sword-edge is part of oath-bond description, retained with subsequent forty oaths.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0074:b004:l016: Nine-year age printed, referent not explicit; English leaves who was nine ambiguous.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0074:b004:l030: Subject of becoming friends compressed between Kanggai's khan and Beijing's khan; no extra named friendship added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0074:b004:l033: Deer made cattle preserved as epic taming image, repeated with gray deer36.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0074:b004:l039: Шай III invisible patron of warriors, https://el-sozduk.kg/шай/; singular holy patron.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0075:b003:l007: Билди interpreted пилди elephant with initial voicing; gold-loading context, raw unchanged.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0075:b003:l009: Dark-eyed thousand interpreted captive people in raiding account; sex not specified or invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0075:b003:l012: Омбу rendered Omsk, conventional Kyrgyz place form, in epic account; no assertion about historically dated conquest.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0075:b003:l018: Жин II stomach contents verified Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/zhin-6/. Printed order is told to spill stomach contents, spilled blood, the REVERSE of dictionary's common кан төк десе жин төккөн. Printed reversal retained, not silently corrected.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0075:b003:l029: Twin metaphor for Manas retained despite not literal biological twins.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0075:b005:l034: Кетик баш чөптү оттотпойт literally not let graze broken-headed grass. Provisionally protection from impoverishment/poor fodder; unusual concrete metaphor retained and exact idiom uncertain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0076:b003:l012: Өлгөндө көргөн idiom child gained only with extreme difficulty, not child born after actual death.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0076:b003:l026: Аяш эне kinship through sworn friendship, rendered sworn mother without asserting biological maternity.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0076:b003:l039: Printed Бяр read as Бир once from context, exact raw kept; image shows apparent Бяр typo.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0076:b004:l018: Даңкан is earth/snow clod thrown up by a horse's hoof, not helmet. Verified Yudakhin exact чоң казандай даңканы, https://el-sozduk.kg/даңкан/. Corrected draft18–19 to clods whirring overhead.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0077:b003:l004: Narration says someone had killed orphan; subsequent lament is Bakai's mistaken inference, followed by reconsideration79–80. Assertion retained without making actual Semetey death true in commentary.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0077:b003:l022: Buraq sacred steed metaphor addressed to child; no additional physical horse inserted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0077:b003:l029: Талмыз = мыкты strong/excellent, verified Seytek1960 editorial glossary PDF261 (zero-index260) https://new.bizdin.kg/media/books/Сейтек._1960_г..pdf. Corrected unsupported duplicate standard to my valiant one; касаба is banner. Seytek1991 glossary PDF352 instead gives талмыз a куурай-like plant; this alternative sense is documented, but1960 adjective reading is provisionally preferred in direct praise of Semetey beside banner. No claim of unique lexical resolution.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0077:b003:l033: Күл ботом read flower calf (күл I=гүл), endearment, not ashes. See https://el-sozduk.kg/КҮЛ/. Repeated37 and80:3:12 retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0077:b004:l011: Даңгыт adult male dog/wolf; exact Даңгыттарга жарамын in1969 dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/ДАҢГЫТ/. Corrected missing object to cut her up for the dogs. Ethnonym Dangyt also exists but dogs reading has exact verbal idiom support.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0077:b004:l036: Мураап=мурапы: inheritance and supportive kinsman;2015also surviving son/heir, https://el-sozduk.kg/мурапы/. Child rendered heir.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0078:b003:l015: Self-reproach curses camel/property stewardship that displaced care of orphan; source changes your/his possessives retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0078:b003:l022: Базар metaphor for joy and lively household retained as lively bazaar, not commerce claim.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0078:b003:l026: Жеп алдым consumed metaphor for responsibility through neglect, not literal cannibalism. Repeated32.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0078:b003:l030: Күн жаң-жуң Chinese imperial commander terminology provisionally rendered Chinese commanders; күн modifier exact scope uncertain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0078:b003:l039: Жети бирге read seven пир spiritual patrons via бир II=пир dictionary; not at age seven because dative plus hand-pledging parallels73.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0078:b004:l020: Кызыталак abusive curse rendered damned; no literal divorce claim.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0078:b004:l029: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0079:b003:l015: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0079:b004:l006: Unspecified they dwelling along river kept; local rhetorical connection to his death is compressed, no invented subject named.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0079:b004:l015: Naked child on Kanykei's shoulder explicitly foretells six months of suffering: supernatural guardian image preserved, not confused with infant Semetey.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0079:b004:l030: Күл II ashes here in fire formula, distinct from flower endearment күл ботом.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0080:b004:l025: Абийир жабыл- means honor is preserved, not lost; https://el-sozduk.kg/абийир/. Reused established lexical finding.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0080:b004:l027: Narrative shifts abruptly to Kumaiyk's origins; absent grammatical subject inferred Manas from whole hound passage and rearer Kanykei. Repetition81retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0080:b004:l035: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0080:b004:l038: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0081:b003:l014: Entire hound-origin and burial sequence repeats from80:27–81:13 through81:15–39. Both printed occurrences fully translated, not deduplicated.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0081:b003:l022: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0081:b003:l025: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0081:b003:l028: Printed Аюудай like a bear, versus Аюудан from a bear at81:3:2; difference retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0081:b005:l031: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0082:b003:l006: Туубай туна чөгөйүн exact self-curse wishing never to have been born, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/туна/. Wording corrected from unsupported literal sinking.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0082:b003:l033: Printed Алгы жол forward/first trail, unlike ensuing seven and three times. Possible алты six typo not silently substituted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0082:b004:l003: Куйругун жаза бастырып compressed tail-pressure image provisionally tucked tail under hurried pursuit; precise idiom uncertain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0082:b004:l014: Conditional threat lacks repeated self-curse conclusion; retained incomplete oath form, no padding.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0082:b004:l034: Subject returns from horse to hound without name; fleeing cave and finding sheep bones identify Kumaiyk, confirmed83:1. English it retains source compression.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0083:b003:l021: Короздой cocklike hero image retained, not changed to wolf or eagle.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0083:b003:l039: Horse pursues hound with Bakai riding; plural chase construction rendered across column transition, no reordered fragments.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0083:b005:l016: Кыргак figurative steadfast ally/support, exact Yudakhin sense3https://el-sozduk.kg/кыргак/. Physical spear-blade sense2 also underlies martial metaphor; rendered support beside bannered spear.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0083:b005:l019: Урмеке resolved by Seytek1991 glossary PDF352 (printed351): reverent address meaning sacred mother (касиеттүү энеке). Primary Kyrgyz glossary https://cdn-1.aki.kg/st_bilimlib/8/6ba4d8da68bdb70850cc2e35ec861c0213e5b51f.pdf; local sources/raw/manas-aki-candidate.pdf SHA68bc80c49971f65cf755f6ef4d49e22396d9ca913b53b1f18aace29563f74178. Worker individually inspected /tmp/seytek1991-glossary352.png after coordinator located entry. Restored whole English verse; no unsupported Mecca reading.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0083:b005:l029: Six hunger days printed here, versus seven73–74; not harmonized.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0083:b005:l036: Five hair divisions printed here, versus four74:11; not harmonized.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0083:b005:l039: Continuous sentence ends at84:3:1 let us die in sacrifice, owned by next batch. This batch keeps its own final verse only, no completion padding.

publication_basis: New direct model Kyrgyz-to-English translation of traditional epic narrative. No machine-translation API or previous English poem translation used. Dictionary and Kyrgyz editorial glosses are lexical aids only; provisional translation and lineation, no expert certification.
